rationale: All feasible runs are limited by an I/O-port path at ss 100C max-RC; reg-to-reg is ~3 ns better. The AREA 3/TD/cap213/post-GRT-timing runs fit T_eff ~ 0.2*T + 10.65 ns: the port path sits on a ~10.6-10.7 ns floor and only the target-scaled I/O delay shrinks, so period_frac 0.45 should reach ~12.3 ns (optimistic; self-consistent period ~13.3 ns). Hold (+0.09 ns, no buffers), slew/cap (4 vs 3053) and DRC (converged at 61% utilisation) leave room to compact. Both copy r2-004 at 0.45 with harder slew/cap repair (40/35) and test one compaction lever on the port floor: A shrinks the die (util 50), B packs placement denser in the same die (45+20).
